description:
**Lightning-fast domain search directly in your AI workflow**

Search domain availability, generate brandable alternatives, and validate bulk domain lists without leaving Claude, Cursor, or any other MCP-compatible environment. Powered by the same sub-10ms API infrastructure behind Instant Domain Search.

**Features:**
- **Bulk availability checking** across multiple TLDs with comprehensive results
- **Smart name variations** that generate pronounceable, brandable alternatives (no random letter spam)
- **Authoritative verification** for any domain list with direct registry validation
- **Privacy-first** architecture that keeps your searches off sales databases and repricing algorithms

Perfect for developers naming projects, entrepreneurs launching products, or anyone who needs to check hundreds of domains in minutes instead of hours.

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.
